assignmentTitle: Fatigue Analysis of a Connecting Rod

criteria.title: Observe the Engine Connecting Rod Mechanism
criteria.description: Understanding client brief, internal combustion engine reciprocating mechanism, connecting rod function, and fatigue design scope.

criteria.title: Identify Connecting Rod & Engine Components
criteria.description: Accurate labeling of piston, piston pin, small end, small-end transition fillet, shank, big-end transition fillet, big end cap, crank pin, crank web, and crankshaft on EA-17.

criteria.title: Understand Engine Load Transmission & Force Flow
criteria.description: Tracing force flow from gas pressure on piston through wrist pin, connecting rod shank, crank pin, web, and crankshaft.

criteria.title: Analyze Gas Force, Inertia Force & Fluctuating Cyclic Loading
criteria.description: Differentiating peak gas force, reciprocating mass inertia force, maximum compressive force (expansion stroke), and maximum tensile force (exhaust/suction stroke).

criteria.title: Identify Fatigue Stress Concentrations & Critical Transition Fillets
criteria.description: Locating stress concentration zones (Kt) at small-end to shank transition fillet and shank-to-big-end cap transition shoulder.

criteria.title: Determine Endurance Limit & Fatigue Strength Factors
criteria.description: Determining surface factor (ka), size factor (kb), reliability factor (kc), temperature factor (kd), and modified endurance limit (Se) for forged steel connecting rod.

criteria.title: Apply Soderberg Fatigue Criterion for Connecting Rod Sizing
criteria.description: Applying modified Soderberg fatigue criteria for fluctuating axial tension-compression stress cycles to calculate required section area and FoS.

criteria.title: Connecting Rod I-Section Geometry & Buckling / Fatigue Verification
criteria.description: Evaluating forged steel I-section geometry (Ixx = 4 Iyy) for optimum strength-to-weight ratio and equal buckling resistance in oscillation vs swing planes.

criteria.title: Practical Fatigue Failure & Overload Analysis
criteria.description: Diagnosing high-cycle axial/bending fatigue cracking at shank transition fillets, hydraulic lock bending overload, and cap bolt fretting.

criteria.title: Connecting Rod Fatigue Analysis & Design Report
criteria.description: Synthesizing comprehensive connecting rod fatigue design report covering gas/inertia force analysis, Soderberg criteria, and material recommendations.
